description: This file defines the LoggerTrait trait within the PSR Log namespace, providing default delegating methods for various log levels to reduce boilerplate in classes implementing logging functionality. It includes method implementations for emergency, alert, critical, error, warning, notice, info, debug, and a generic log method, which must be implemented by classes using this trait.

methods.name: emergency
methods.description: Delegates the 'emergency' log level message to the 'log' method with level LogLevel::EMERGENCY.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Delegates the 'alert' log level message to the 'log' method with level LogLevel::ALERT.

methods.name: critical
methods.description: Delegates the 'critical' log level message to the 'log' method with level LogLevel::CRITICAL.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Delegates the 'error' log level message to the 'log' method with level LogLevel::ERROR.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Delegates the 'warning' log level message to the 'log' method with level LogLevel::WARNING.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Delegates the 'notice' log level message to the 'log' method with level LogLevel::NOTICE.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Delegates the 'info' log level message to the 'log' method with level LogLevel::INFO.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Delegates the 'debug' log level message to the 'log' method with level LogLevel::DEBUG.

methods.name: log
methods.description: An abstract method that must be implemented by the class including this trait; responsible for the actual logging at any level.
